info.title: Strata API
info.description:
Everything the web app does goes through this API: automation systems (Companion / Stream Deck, newsroom MOS gateways, sports data feeds) have the same power as the UI.

**Authentication**: `Authorization: Bearer <API key>` (create one in *Users → API keys*), or the `cg_session` cookie of the web app.

**Real time**: `GET /ws` (WebSocket) pushes `hello`, `project`, `projectDeleted`, `channels` and `channel` events, and accepts `{"type":"command","channelId":"main","command":{…}}`. `/ws?channel=<id>` follows one channel (HTML5 output pages; public when *public outputs* is on).

Units: frames are project frames; times are Unix milliseconds.

Pages embedded in other applications (newsroom MOS plugin `/mos/plugin`) may pass an API key as `?key=pcg_…`.

The same actions over OSC (UDP, `/strata/{channel}/…`) and a TCP text protocol (`{channel} take 2`), when enabled in the settings. Rights: admin, designer, operator of the channel.

post.summary: Render a graphic to a video file with alpha
post.description:
QuickTime (.mov), PNG codec with alpha (Premiere, After Effects, Resolve, Avid). The clip plays the template like on air: animation in, `hold` seconds on air, then the out animation (`includeOut`), or the clip timeline given by `timing`. The project format closest to width × height is used (9:16 sequences get the 9:16 layout). At most 300 s.

**Rights:** everyone but viewers.

timing.description: The clip's own timeline (the Premiere panel): the clip lasts `duration` seconds and leaves each stop of the template at the second given in `stops`. The stops are the template's pause markers and its on-air (out) marker, in frame order, one per frame. An animation with more time than it needs plays at its speed then holds on its stop; one with less is played faster. `hold` and `includeOut` are then not used.

post.description:
Creates a template from an After Effects composition exported with the Bodymovin or LottieFiles extension: the `.json`, a `.zip` with `data.json` and `images/`, or a `.lottie`. Rectangles, ellipses, solids, texts (each becomes a data field), images, null objects, parenting, precomps, transforms and keyframes with their easing are converted; markers named “pause” / “on air” / “out” become playout markers. Unsupported features are listed in `warnings`. A `.mogrt` is refused with an explanation: it wraps a binary After Effects project.

**Rights:** admin, designer.

A disabled connection takes and drops them.

get.description:
Connections followed, rules, display options, hashtags, the incoming messages (the last 1000, in memory), the approved queue and the message on air. Changes come on the WebSocket as `{"type": "social", "projectId", "change": {"kind": "incoming" | "removed" | "queue" | "settings" | "hashtags" | "reload", …}}`.

Templates read it as the push data source `social-<project id>`: `{ onAir, next, approved: [Msg], count, hashtags: { <tag>: { tag, count, perMin, series, platforms } } }`, Msg = `{ id, platform, platformName, name, handle, city, text, avatar, photo, amount, at, time }`.

**Rights:** whoever sees the project.

put.description:
Their last messages come in; the incoming ones of connections left go. The data source `social-<project id>` is created the first time.

**Rights:** admin, designer, operator who see the project.

The incoming messages are read again with them.

post.summary: Moderate, or drive what goes on air
post.description:
Idempotent by message id: `approve`, `reject`, `remove` (out of the queue), `star` (`on`), `edit` (`text`, `nameMode`) take `id`; `reorder` takes `ids` (the queue in order). `take` (`id`), `next` (`from`: only while this one is on air) and `out` go through the channel commands (zone locks, undo, as-run log): the template is taken, or updated when already on air. `rotation` (`on`, `secs`): next by itself. `reset` (`tag`): a hashtag from zero.

**Rights:** admin, designer, operator who see the project. On air: the right to operate the channel.

lang.description: Language of the interface ("en", "fr"); empty = the browser's.

password.description: Required on creation (8+ characters); empty keeps the current one on edit.

layer.description: Stacking order (higher = in front); also the playout layer.

transition.description: sequential: the graphic on air goes out before the new one comes in.

areas.description: Area of the zone by format id ("main", "9x16"…), in fractions of the frame; a designer guide.

zone.description: Zone id; empty = the template's zone.

Template.description: A graphic: timeline (frames), markers, data fields and layers. See web/src/engine/types.ts for the full layer model.

binding.description: Live value from a data source; replaces what the operator types while the source has a value at the path.

logic.description: Relations between values (node graph), evaluated every frame after animation and bindings. Node `type`: `layerProp` {layer, prop}, `textSize` {layer, metric: width|height|lines|chars}, `field` {key}, `constant` {value}, `math` {op: add|sub|mul|div|min|max|abs|round|floor|ceil; inputs a, b}, `clamp` {min, max; input in}, `condition` {cmp: gt|ge|lt|le|eq|ne|empty|notEmpty; inputs a, b, then, else}, `target` {layer, prop, mode: set|add|multiply; input in}. Edges connect a node's output to an input `port` of another node.

language.description: Language of the texts ("fr", "en", "de", "es", "it"): hyphenation, French spaces, and the day and month names of the Clock widgets that follow the project (`lang` "" on a clock layer).

renditions.description: Other pictures of the channel (9:16…), driven by the same takes; HTML5 at /output/<channel>/<rendition>.

slate.description: Still picture shown while no project is loaded ("" = none).

SlateStyle.description: What a channel picture shows while no project is loaded: a built-in design (Aurora, Bento, Gradient, Frame, Lines, Split: "Strata Graphics", the channel name, size, ratio and frame rate), `transparent` (nothing) or `custom`, its still picture (`slate`). Not set in the settings: `custom` when a still picture is set, else `aurora`.

age.description: Project frames on air since the take.

next.description: Take waiting for this graphic to go out (sequential zones).

clocks.description: Widgets controlled by the operator, by layer id: offset and pausedAt in frames on air.

layers.description: Playout layer (zone stacking order) → graphic on air.

Command.description: Target a zone by id (`zone`) or a raw playout layer (`layer`). A take without either plays in the template's zone; a clear without either clears everything. `trigger` (with `name`) applies to the whole channel.

target.description: widget: layer id or name of a timed widget (timer, stopwatch, ticker, roll, counter…), or `*` for all of them

control.description: widget: start (resume), pause, toggle, reset (to zero, keeps running or paused), restart (to zero and running)

name.description: trigger: resumes every graphic holding on a pause that waits for this trigger

dataset.description: row: key or name of a data set of the graphic on air

row.description: row: the row to show (1 = first); the graphic changes the way its data set says (out › in, crossfade or cut)

fade.description: update: the old values cross-fade out (½ s) instead of a cut

ServerConfig.description: config.json: name, bind, publicOutputs, timezone and channels (format, outputs, loaded project: `projectId`, null for none, kept as it is on air when settings are saved; `slate` and `slateStyle` (SlateStyle) of the main picture and of each rendition).

Format.description: Alternative layout of a project (the main one is the project's width × height, id "main"). Layers carry per-format overrides; each output uses the format closest to its aspect ratio.

url.description: json, csv, rss, xml. A Google Sheets link is read as CSV (sheet shared with anyone who has the link).

header.description: csv: the first line names the columns (default true)

format.description: push: format of the values sent

project.description: The project it belongs to (its Connectors page); absent = shared by every project (the Data page of the main menu). Set when created, never changed.

rules.description: Validation rules, checked after every fetch or push. `field`: `score` is that value when the source's value has it, else that column of every row of its main list (the longest list, up to three levels down); `rows[].score` is that column of every row of the list `rows` (`[].score`: of a value that is a list). Broken rules are only warnings.

issues.description: The rules the current value breaks (at most 100).

required.description: An empty or missing value breaks it (else empty values are not checked).

pattern.description: text: a regular expression the text must contain (`^…$` for the whole text)

format.description: date: `DD/MM/YYYY`, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm`… or strftime (`%d/%m/%Y`); absent = ISO 8601

equals.description: calc: the sum of `field` over the rows expected

list.description: The list of the row (dotted path, "" = the value itself).

row.description: Row in that list (0 = first); null for a single value or a sum.

params.description: `limit` broken, or `expected`, `tolerance` and `sum` for a sum.

V1ChannelStatus.description: What a control surface shows for a channel.

tally.description: `pgm` on air, `pvw` taken and waiting for its zone to clear, `cue` what `next` takes.

warnings.description: Rows (or values) of the data sources of its template that break their rules (a warning only: it can still be taken).

paused.description: Holding on a pause that waits for Continue or a trigger.

surfaces.description: Control surfaces connected (feedback sockets, TCP, OSC senders of the last minute)

control.description: The OSC and TCP listeners: `{osc: {enabled, port}, tcp: {enabled, port}}`.

action.description: take, out, continue, update, clear, row, widget, trigger

time.description: Time of day in the server's time zone

tc.description: Time-of-day timecode at the channel's frame rate

settings.description: youtube: apiKey, mode (channelLive | video), channel (@handle or UC…), video (id or link), read (chat,superChats,members,polls). twitch: channel. facebook: accessToken, mode (live | post), page, post. instagram: accessToken, mode (recent | media), igUser, media. x: bearer, query. tiktok: user, hookToken. whatsapp: verifyToken, accessToken, appSecret, phoneNumberId, hookToken. sms: keyword, accountSid, authToken, hookToken. Secrets (apiKey, accessToken, bearer, appSecret, authToken, verifyToken) are never read back.

offAir.description: Connected, but no live is running.

id.description: Platform account id, or the full phone number.

SocialRules.description: Rules of a project (every key optional). Actions: `reject`, `check`, `fix`, `mask`.

builtin.description: With the built-in insults, slurs and threats

channelId.description: A channel the project is loaded on

fixed.description: Text on air after the rules

edit.description: Text on air set by a moderator

series.description: Per minute, the last 60, oldest first

history.description: Per minute since `since` (6 h at most)

sourceId.description: The data source templates read: `social-<project id>`
